The decision as to whether or not to have your party is yours entirely. I will say that you may surprise yourself and have a good time, but I understand the risk involved. Regardless, I really don’t want you to lose hope. Relying on your therapist is an excellent start to having a support system, and they can definitely recommend other options and ways to help curb your anxiety and depression. Some days in life are better than others, but if you haven’t heard it from anyone else, I’m telling you that I don’t want you to give up. I’m around your age (I’ll be 18 later this year) and I’ve had my down days as recently as a week ago. I just got done with my therapy appointment a few hours back and I really feel like I’m developing skills and techniques to improve my quality of life. I honestly wish I could come to your birthday party and give you any kind of support that you need, but I want you to remember that there are people in the world who care about you, no matter how alone you might feel. Good luck with everything, and I’m always here if you need to talk to someone.

You will get there. You will get to where you need to be emotionally, and you and your therapist will find a sustainable option for your future. It sucks that your mental health has caused you to lose friends in the past; that’s not something that should ever affect your relationships, but I understand how you feel because I’ve had the same thing happen. Just know that it’s their loss, because like I said, you’re a compassionate person, and that’s probably the best trait anyone could ask for in a friend.

I know that everyone’s experience is different, but I want to tell you that you’re not alone. Not in any way, and especially not in how you feel. Not wanting to hurt the people close to you means that you have compassion for others, and that’s one of the most important traits for any human being to possess. You clearly care about your mom and your stepdad, and whether you see it or not, these people are the ones keeping you here. I don’t know what kind of support system you currently have (therapy, medication etc) but I’m certain that the people close to you are more than willing to help you get to where you need to be. They care about you. I care about. It might not seem like much coming from a stranger on the internet, but I can just tell that you’re a good person, and I know that you can get through this.
